name: pi pod
description: Runs pi coding-agent sessions in isolated remote sandboxes on a server you host, and lets you attach from a terminal CLI or iOS and Android apps. For developers who self-host.

skills.name: Remote pods
skills.description: Launches a pi session in a sandboxed pod for the current directory and attaches to it.

skills.name: Phone apps
skills.description: Drives the same pod sessions from the iOS and Android apps over the server's gateway.

skills.name: Self-hosted deployment
skills.description: Installs and upgrades the server, sandbox service and Postgres as one Compose project.
